title: Processing of Pacbio Iso-seq Sequences
author: Bing Cheng; Agnelo Furtado; Robert Henry
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ja3cign

steps.title: Remove Primer IIA sequences
steps.instruction: Remove the Primer IIA sequence motifs used in library preparations from the sequences.

steps.title: Remove redundant sequences
steps.instruction: Remove redundant sequences to generate dataset A.

steps.title: Filter against C. arabica chloroplast genome
steps.instruction: Perform BLASTn (1e-10) of dataset A against the complete C. arabica chloroplast genome (Accession: EF044213.1) using CLC genomic workbench.

steps.title: Filter against mitochondrial genomes
steps.instruction: Perform BLASTn (1e-10) of dataset B against the N. tabacum and V. vinifera complete mitochondrial genomes (Accession: BA000042.1 and FM179380.1) using CLC genomic workbench.

steps.title: Filter against ribosomal genes
steps.instruction: Perform BLASTn (1e-10) of dataset C against public available ribosomal genes from C. arabica, C. canephora, and C. eugenioides (Accession: AJ224846, EU650386, DQ153609, AF416459, EU650384, EU650385, AF542981, AF542990, JX459583, JX459584, JX459585, JX459586, JX459587, DQ153593, AF542982, DQ423064, DQ153609, DQ153588, DQ153621, AF542986) using CLC genomic workbench.

steps.title: Filter against virus and viroid genomes
steps.instruction: Perform BLASTn (1e-10) of dataset D against reference genomes of virus and viroid downloaded from NCBI using CLC genomic workbench.

steps.title: Filter against prokaryote genomes
steps.instruction: Perform BLASTn (1e-10) of dataset E against the reference genome of prokaryotes downloaded from NCBI using CLC genomic workbench.

steps.title: Filter against fungal proteins
steps.instruction: Perform BLASTx (1e-10) of dataset F against fungal proteins downloaded from NCBI using CLC genomic workbench.

steps.title: Filter and confirm significant matches
steps.instruction: Filter and validate significant matches using the following criteria in CLC genomic workbench:

substeps.instruction: Filter matches with bit score (X) ≥ 300 and identity ≥ 80%.
Confirm significant matches with cloud BLASTn (bit score (Y)).

steps.title: Assess sequence quality
steps.instruction: Assess the sequence quality of the resulting dataset (dataset G) using Fasta Statistics through Galaxy/GVL 4.0.
